summary: Review survey and scale studies for construct validity, item handling, reliability, measurement invariance, response process and score interpretation.

must_inspect.why: A score is only interpretable if the construct, item mapping and scoring rule are coherent.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat a named validated scale as automatically valid in every population.

must_inspect.why: Internal consistency is not construct validity and may be misleading under multidimensionality.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand one preferred reliability coefficient without design context.

must_inspect.why: Group comparisons can require evidence that the measurement model is comparable across groups/time.
false_positive_guards: Do not require invariance analysis when no cross-group/longitudinal comparison is claimed.
